# CurseVision 发行包

这里收录工程导论项目历次 Windows x64 发行包，以及后来集成到 CurseVision 的独立校园网助手。
下载对应 ZIP 后完整解压，阅读版本说明并运行其中的客户端。每个目录的 README 记录该版的主要更新。

| 版本 | 主要更新 | 发行包与说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| beta0.5 | 首版用电记录和热水器试算 | [ZIP](https://github.com/CurSEyy/cursevision/releases/download/distribution-archive/CurseVision-beta0.5-win-x64.zip) · [README](CurseVision/README.md) |
| Beta0.6 | 账户、好友与界面更新 | [ZIP](https://github.com/CurSEyy/cursevision/releases/download/distribution-archive/CurseVision-Beta0.6-win-x64.zip) · [README](CurseVision-Beta0.6/README.md) |
| beta0.7 | 多段热水器排程和一周估算 | [ZIP](https://github.com/CurSEyy/cursevision/releases/download/distribution-archive/CurseVision-beta0.7-win-x64.zip) · [README](CurseVision-beta0.7/README.md) |
| 0.75 | 按原预约求解三档加热方案 | [ZIP](https://github.com/CurSEyy/cursevision/releases/download/distribution-archive/CurseVision-0.75-win-x64.zip) · [README](CurseVision-0.75/README.md) |
| 0.8 | 可行备选与避课排程 | [ZIP](https://github.com/CurSEyy/cursevision/releases/download/distribution-archive/CurseVision-0.8-win-x64.zip) · [README](CurseVision-0.8/README.md) |
| alpha0.9 | 校园网认证、采纳与共享 | [ZIP](https://github.com/CurSEyy/cursevision/releases/download/distribution-archive/CurseVision-alpha0.9-win-x64.zip) · [README](CurseVision-alpha0.9/README.md) |
| 0.95alpha | 白底课表识别和应用图标 | [ZIP](https://github.com/CurSEyy/cursevision/releases/download/distribution-archive/CurseVision-0.95alpha-win-x64.zip) · [README](CurseVision-0.95alpha/README.md) |
| 1.0release | HWiNFO 整机功率接入 | [ZIP](https://github.com/CurSEyy/cursevision/releases/download/distribution-archive/CurseVision-1.0release-win-x64.zip) · [README](CurseVision-1.0release/README.md) |
| 0.1.1（独立工具） | 校园网助手交接包 | [ZIP](https://github.com/CurSEyy/cursevision/releases/download/distribution-archive/BJTUCampusWifi-0.1.1-complete-handoff.1.zip) · [README](BJTUCampusWifi-0.1.1/README.md) |

各 ZIP 保留发布时的内容。历史用法保存在对应版本的 README，更新说明根据本项目的开发对话和原发行包交叉核对。
校园网助手的接手 README 和清单也随原 ZIP 一同提供。
